fusions.name: Cloud of Stings
fusions.desc: Throws 3 barbed darts at once in a spread out to 6 tiles, and each deals 3 damage. Its damage rises 15% for each affliction the target carries (max 60%).

fusions.name: Hooked Sting
fusions.desc: A thrust that deals 8 damage and leaves its barb in the wound, making the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds. Also costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Honeycomb Drop
fusions.desc: Knocks a hive loose with the butt of the shaft. For 12 seconds its swarm stings an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second, each sting with a 30% chance to leave it [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Work Without Rest
fusions.desc: Each time you spend stamina, a stinging bolt leaps to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles and deals 5 damage. Once every 3 seconds.
